note: No presentation — a read presents the room-issued chain exactly as a write does; a host never authorizes a room read from a session or ACL of its own.
Two blobs on one record — a record carries at most one file in this version, and the response echoes what put 0.2 could write.
An empty blobs array — absence is how 'no file' is written; an empty array would give one record two spellings.
A sealed-at version of 0 — `sealed.version` names the version a body was sealed at, and no record is ever at version 0.
